title: net1 v4 held-out families: competitors, loss, RTT, buffers
description: Test data no net1 v4 training set has: competing BBRv3 and Westwood flows, random loss of 3% to 6%, one-way delay of 61 to 90 ms, buffers of 8 to 16 BDP, 150 links each (examples/net1_broad.py, sets ood-*).
prepare: for s in ood-competitors ood-loss ood-rtt ood-buffer; do uv run python examples/net1_broad.py "$OUT/spec-$s" --set $s --models "$IN/models"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$s/campaign.json" "$OUT/campaign-$s"; done
run: for s in ood-competitors ood-loss ood-rtt ood-buffer; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$OUT/campaign-$s" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps --steps-stride 6; done
collect: echo '| set | status |' > "$OUT/summary.md"; echo '|---|---|' >> "$OUT/summary.md"; for s in ood-competitors ood-loss ood-rtt ood-buffer; do uv run expliccit campaign status "$OUT/campaign-$s" > "$OUT/status-$s.json"; echo "| $s | $(jq -c . "$OUT/status-$s.json") |" >> "$OUT/summary.md"; done
